description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hire and onboard a new employee" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedIdentified" name="Department identifies need for a new hire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteForInterview" name="Invite selected candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat" name="Choose interview format"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationChoice" name="Salary negotiation?" default="Flow_NegotiationNotNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideOrientation" name="Provide orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FullyIntegrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteForInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09_InPerson" name="In-person preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers an in-person interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_Virtual" name="Virtual preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers a virtual interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationNeeded" name="Negotiation takes place" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationChoice" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Salary negotiation takes place</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationNotNeeded" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationChoice" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="End_FullyIntegrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
